name: Gloas
description: Star of 5,950 K, 228 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-13 b crosses Gloas as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: WASP-13
quotes.card: WASP-13, also named Gloas, is a star in the Lynx constellation.
quotes.introduction: The star is similar, in terms of metallicity and mass, to the Sun, although it is hotter and most likely older.
